description: This file defines the AcceptanceTester class used for acceptance testing in a SuiteCRM project, extending Codeception's Actor class with custom methods for login, logout, navigation, and validation.

classes.name: AcceptanceTester
classes.description: A specialized actor class for acceptance testing with custom methods for SuiteCRM interactions.

methods.name: getFaker
methods.description: Returns a Faker generator instance for generating fake data during tests.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with provided username and password.

methods.name: dontSeeMissingLabels
methods.description: Checks that no missing label placeholders ('LBL_') are visible.

methods.name: dontSeeErrors
methods.description: Checks that no common error or warning messages are visible on the page.

methods.name: visitPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specific module and view, optionally to a specific record.
